cohort: 30 patients with amniotic fluid index (AFI) <8 on ultrasound scan during their late second trimester, excluding those with congenital anomalies on ultrasound, preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM), and drug-induced oligohydramnios.
finding: Low molecular weight heparin (LMWH) treatment in patients with late second-trimester oligohydramnios resulted in significant improvement in amniotic fluid index in 26 out of 30 patients, with an average birth weight of 2.5kg and an average APGAR score of 7.
mod_finding: Twelve patients had vaginal deliveries and 18 had elective Cesarean sections.
birth_weight: average 2.5kg, eight premature low birth weight (LBW) babies out of 28 live births
